title: You Need To Listen To This Leading COVID-19 Expert From South Korea | STAY CURIOUS #15
summary: Asian Boss interviews Professor Kim Woo-joo of Korea University Guro Hospital about COVID-19 in early 2020. He covers masks, testing, aerosol spread, and South Korea's response.
why: In early pandemic threads, HN commenters pointed to it as an uninterrupted, practical expert view from Korea on masks, testing and airborne spread.

quote.text: The videos are excellent because the doctors are not interrupted with questions.
